# Provider logos (SVGL)

Downloaded 2026-10-25 from the SVGL catalogue (https://svgl.app, API https://api.svgl.app).
Bundled so the app never calls SVGL at runtime. Checked: no `<script>`, event handlers or remote references.

| File                  | Source                                       | Brand                                    |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `claude-ai-icon.svg`  | https://svgl.app/library/claude-ai-icon.svg  | Claude — Anthropic                       |
| `anthropic_white.svg` | https://svgl.app/library/anthropic_white.svg | Anthropic                                |
| `gemini.svg`          | https://svgl.app/library/gemini.svg          | Gemini — Google                          |
| `openai_dark.svg`     | https://svgl.app/library/openai_dark.svg     | OpenAI (Codex, later)                    |
| `github_dark.svg`     | https://svgl.app/library/github_dark.svg     | GitHub — repository link                 |
| `bmc.svg`             | https://svgl.app/library/bmc.svg             | Buy Me a Coffee — optional donation link |

These marks belong to their owners and are not covered by Noburi's licence. Use them only to name the
provider a feature connects to, unmodified, following each brand's guidelines. Review before public release.
